aliens.title: Joe
aliens.desc: Just a guy. No ability.

aliens.title: Gen-57
aliens.desc: Mass-produced clone. No ability.

aliens.title: President
aliens.desc: Elected, somehow. No ability.

aliens.title: King
aliens.desc: Rules by birthright. No ability.

aliens.title: DJ
aliens.desc: Loud. No ability.

aliens.title: Space Fence
aliens.desc: Spawns with a one-turn shield that blocks all damage.

aliens.title: Spaceship
aliens.desc: Takes flight every second turn. While flying it is immune to almost everything.

aliens.title: VR Workout
aliens.desc: Very fit. No ability.

aliens.title: Old Granny
aliens.desc: If she was hurt this turn, lurches an extra tile forward before everyone moves.

aliens.title: Albot
aliens.desc: Hevalten. Spawns a random alien in its row every turn.

aliens.title: Jumper
aliens.desc: Leaps over any wall in its way.

aliens.title: Giant
aliens.desc: Enormous, but only moves every other turn.

aliens.title: Gardener
aliens.desc: Walls cannot be placed in any lane the Gardener occupies.

aliens.title: Army
aliens.desc: Hevalten. Every Army on the field lowers all of your damage by 2%.

aliens.title: Morpher
aliens.desc: Turns into a different alien every turn, keeping its health percentage.

aliens.title: Fusion
aliens.desc: On spawn, fuses two aliens into one with 1.5x their combined health.

aliens.title: Crippler
aliens.desc: Common weapons deal 25% less damage while it lives.

aliens.title: Splashfest
aliens.desc: Immune to all splash damage.

aliens.title: Virus
aliens.desc: Every weapon that has a cooldown takes one turn longer to recharge.

aliens.title: Guardian
aliens.desc: Hevalten. Absorbs all damage aimed at its lane. Immune to poison, knockback and hypnosis.

aliens.title: Dark Arts
aliens.desc: Hevalten. On spawn, upgrades the three aliens closest to your base into stronger ones.

aliens.title: Rarebane
aliens.desc: Rare weapons deal 20% less damage while it lives.

aliens.title: Bunker
aliens.desc: All targeted damage against it is halved.

aliens.title: Interdimensional
aliens.desc: Every one on the field reduces all damage by 7.5%.

aliens.title: Scarcebane
aliens.desc: Hevalten. Scarce weapons deal 20% less damage while it lives.

aliens.title: Heval God
aliens.desc: Hevalten. If it was hurt this turn, calls a random Hevalten into the first three rows.

aliens.title: God of Space
aliens.desc: Hevalten. Spawns three more aliens on arrival. Immune to knockback, poison and hypnosis.

aliens.title: Swarmling
aliens.desc: Tiny and fast: moves two rows every turn.

aliens.title: Shieldbearer
aliens.desc: Each turn, shields the alien directly ahead of it for one turn.

aliens.title: Phaser
aliens.desc: Half damage from lane attacks. Double damage from tile and single-target attacks.

aliens.title: Medic
aliens.desc: Each turn, heals every other alien for 10% of its maximum health.

aliens.title: Thief
aliens.desc: Steals 5 gold from you every turn it is alive.

aliens.title: Splitter
aliens.desc: When it dies, breaks into two Swarmlings that each carry a quarter of its health.

aliens.title: Anchor
aliens.desc: Nothing in its lane can be knocked back, pulled or moved by your weapons.

aliens.title: Necromancer
aliens.desc: Hevalten. Every third turn, raises the last alien you killed at half health in its row.

aliens.title: Void Titan
aliens.desc: Hevalten. No single hit can deal more than 5000 damage to it.

weapons.name: Asteroid Rain
weapons.desc: Deals 175 damage to every alien on the field.

weapons.name: Poison Arrow
weapons.desc: Deals 150 damage to a lane and poisons every alien in it for 55 damage per turn.

weapons.name: Triple Threat
weapons.desc: Deals 200 damage to three tiles of your choice.

weapons.name: Cosmic Fire
weapons.desc: Deals 250 damage to every alien in a lane.

weapons.name: Astrobolt
weapons.desc: Deals 150 damage to a lane and stuns the two closest aliens for one turn.

weapons.name: Star Blast
weapons.desc: Deals 160 damage in a cross around a tile of your choice.

weapons.name: Laser Kill
weapons.desc: Instantly kills every alien in a lane with 600 health or less. Ignores buffs.

weapons.name: Stellar Boost
weapons.desc: All weapons deal +20% damage this turn and +10% for the next two.

weapons.name: Gravity Well
weapons.desc: Drags every alien in a lane one row back toward the top of the field.

weapons.name: Ricochet
weapons.desc: Deals 300 damage to the closest alien in a lane, then bounces into a neighbouring lane for 200 more.

weapons.name: Scanner
weapons.desc: Marks every alien on the field. Marked aliens take 25% more damage until the end of the turn.

weapons.name: Thunder Strike
weapons.desc: Deals 700 damage to a lane. 33% chance to stun the closest alien, and to keep chaining down the lane.

weapons.name: Battle Ram
weapons.desc: Deals 1050 damage to the closest alien in a lane and knocks it back one tile.

weapons.name: Electro Jolt
weapons.desc: Stuns every alien in a lane for one turn.

weapons.name: Dagger Throw
weapons.desc: Deals 900 damage to every alien in a lane.

weapons.name: Hevalbane
weapons.desc: Deals 1200 damage to the closest alien in a lane. Double damage against Hevalten.

weapons.name: Recursive Explosion
weapons.desc: Deals 500 damage to every alien on the field.

weapons.name: Dueltroid
weapons.desc: Randomly stuns either the closest alien in a lane for 4 turns, or the two closest for 2 turns.

weapons.name: Fresh Start
weapons.desc: Sends a 3x3 block of aliens back to the start of the field.

weapons.name: Chain Lightning
weapons.desc: Deals 800 damage to a tile, then arcs to the four nearest aliens anywhere on the field, losing 20% per jump.

weapons.name: Time Warp
weapons.desc: Freezes time: no alien moves at the end of this turn. Works on everything, even shielded aliens.

weapons.name: Barricade
weapons.desc: Builds a reinforced wall on a tile of your choice. It takes three hits before it breaks.

weapons.name: Santa Axe
weapons.desc: Deals 2200 damage to every alien in a lane.

weapons.name: Lockdown
weapons.desc: Nothing can spawn in the lane you choose next turn. Hevalten ignore it.

weapons.name: Off Guard
weapons.desc: Stuns every alien on the field for one turn.

weapons.name: Laser Beam
weapons.desc: Instantly kills every alien in a lane with 6000 health or less. Ignores buffs.

weapons.name: Mind Blast
weapons.desc: Deals 7001 damage to the closest alien in a lane. If it survives, it is hypnotised and fights for you.

weapons.name: Grenade Launcher
weapons.desc: Deals 3950 damage to every alien in the front and back rows.

weapons.name: Bulwark
weapons.desc: Deals 1500 damage to a lane and permanently raises all damage by 2.5% for the rest of the stage.

weapons.name: Hypnosis
weapons.desc: Hypnotises the closest alien in every lane. They turn and attack their own side.

weapons.name: Plague
weapons.desc: Infects a lane with a plague that deals 400 damage per turn and spreads to every neighbouring alien each turn.

weapons.name: Overclock
weapons.desc: Instantly readies your other two weapons, even if they are recharging.

weapons.name: Executioner
weapons.desc: Deals 3000 damage to the closest alien in a lane. If that alien is below half health, it dies outright instead.

weapons.name: Galactic Beam
weapons.desc: Deals 8000 damage to every alien in a lane.

weapons.name: Solar Flare
weapons.desc: Deals 3000 damage to every alien on the field.

weapons.name: Comet Strike
weapons.desc: Deals 8000 damage to every alien in a 3x3 block.

weapons.name: Death Virus
weapons.desc: Wipes out every alien in a random lane.

weapons.name: Void Burst
weapons.desc: Deals 11000 damage to three tiles of your choice.

weapons.name: Celestial Disruption
weapons.desc: Drops four non-Hevalten aliens in a lane to 1 health.

weapons.name: Quantum Flux
weapons.desc: Deals 3000 damage to every alien. Every alien it kills explodes for 1500 damage to its neighbours, which can chain.

weapons.name: Supernova
weapons.desc: Burns away 20% of the maximum health of every alien on the field.

weapons.name: Doomsday Clock
weapons.desc: Marks an alien for death. Two turns later it dies, no matter what protects it.

weapons.name: Meteor Storm
weapons.desc: Six meteors each hunt down a different alien for 6000 damage. Spare meteors crater empty ground.
